strengths: strict schemas for handoff, numeric provenance, citation state, and paper state
numeric claims can be recomputed from JSON, JSONL, CSV, or TSV
terminal gates fail on unresolved evidence, citations, blockers, or stale builds
network citation failures are recorded rather than treated as empty evidence
claims are explicitly weakened when evidence is missing
profile_blockers: default workflow includes external citation verification
review and story references include new-experiment planning
venue and submission packaging are outside scope
handoff schemas do not by themselves require HTML/PDF block locators
record_build executable parsing fails on unquoted Windows paths
